title: Stream Decoding with Confidence Scores at Room and Cryogenic Temperatures
summary: In fault-tolerant quantum computing, fast and accurate decoding is crucial. Snowflake is a decoder for the surface code that runs in a streaming fashion. In this paper, we implement Snowflake on commercial FPGAs and validate them at room and cryogenic temperatures. Our results demonstrate high decoding throughput for small code distances that, when extrapolated, remains within acceptable limits for larger distances.
